summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation and stock reservation system. Supports atomic line reservation, priority-based order processing (expedited before normal), idempotency by order ID, and rejection of invalid orders or malformed lines without mutating input data or consumed stock on failure.

requirements.description: Reserve all lines of an order together or none at all, aggregating repeated SKU lines and rejecting reservations when stock is insufficient.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: warehouse stock and order line items specifying SKU and quantity
acceptance.when: reservation is evaluated for an order
acceptance.then: quantities for duplicate SKUs are summed, and if all aggregated quantities are available in stock, they are atomically deducted; otherwise no stock is deducted and reason 'insufficient_stock' is returned

requirements.description: Dispatch expedited orders before normal orders while preserving relative arrival order within each priority tier.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: a list of orders containing both expedited and normal priority orders
acceptance.when: orders are fulfilled against warehouse stock
acceptance.then: all valid expedited orders are processed in their input arrival sequence before any normal priority orders are processed

requirements.description: Enforce order ID idempotency by processing only the first occurrence of an order ID and ignoring subsequent duplicates.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: an order sequence that contains duplicate order IDs
acceptance.then: only the initial occurrence of each ID is evaluated, and any later order bearing that ID is ignored completely

requirements.description: Reject malformed lines and invalid orders without mutating caller input objects or modifying stock.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: orders with invalid lines or invalid metadata and original stock inputs
acceptance.when: reservation or order fulfillment is invoked
acceptance.then: invalid lines return 'invalid_lines' and invalid orders return 'invalid_order' without altering stock, leaving input objects unmutated

assumptions: Stock is represented as a plain object mapping non-empty SKU strings to non-negative safe integers; any violation throws a TypeError.
Order IDs must be non-empty exact strings; missing or empty IDs are rejected with id null and reason 'invalid_order'.
Order priority must be strictly 'expedited' or 'normal'; identifiable first occurrences with invalid priority claim their ID and are rejected as 'invalid_order'.
Duplicate order IDs encountered after the first occurrence are completely ignored from processing and reporting.
Invalid order rejections are listed first in original input order, followed by reservation failures in order of fulfillment processing.
Stock and order input objects are never mutated by any reservation or fulfillment function.
